rationale: The request presents workflow-level obstruction caused by a necessary approval constraint and asks for a non-modifying replacement motion and verification plan, so Fructal applies in Redesign mode. The response inspected the fixture read-only, preserved the approval requirement, distinguished the observed blocked state and provided constraint from inferred conclusions and material open questions, and proposed a coherent end-to-end approval lifecycle with ownership, durable source-of-truth state, preserved work, recovery, cancellation handling, handoff continuity, accessibility, and untouched-state checks. The fixture hashes and content are unchanged, so no modification was attempted. The proposal is explicitly described as unvalidated, and affected-actor testing is an acceptance requirement rather than a claimed result.
